core_meaning.primary_meaning: Adan is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Eden, Aden”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Adan corresponds to the Arabic form عدنان (ع د ن). Its core sense is caller to prayer (muezzin). The source record gave عدن ('Eden, Aden'), a place name, with the gloss 'Caller to prayer, Prophet'. The intended name may be عدنان (ʿAdnān). The identification is uncertain.
